name: Margin pressure signal
description: Supported disclosure of adverse pressure on operating or gross margin
notes: Separate operational evidence from the realised financial outcome

name: Restructuring cost signal
description: Quantified or supported restructuring cost disclosure
notes: Amounts require currency and scale normalisation

name: Cost reduction programme
description: Announced programme intended to reduce the cost base
notes: Pressure marker until delivery and context are evidenced

name: Productivity improvement signal
description: Supported improvement in output per input or delivered efficiency
notes: Claims require outcome or quantified support

name: Efficiency deterioration signal
description: Supported deterioration in conversion efficiency or operating leverage

name: Site closure signal
description: Announced or completed closure of an operating site
notes: Planned optimisation and distress closures require contextual separation

name: Capacity expansion signal
description: Announced or delivered increase in productive capacity
notes: Modifier only until demand and utilisation context are supported

name: Underutilisation signal
description: Supported evidence that productive capacity is materially underused

name: Footprint consolidation signal
description: Consolidation or rationalisation of operating locations
notes: Pressure and future benefit may coexist

name: Utilisation improvement signal
description: Supported increase in productive utilisation without material service harm

name: Headcount reduction signal
description: Supported material reduction in workforce or roles
notes: Voluntary productivity change and distress reduction require separation

name: Leadership churn signal
description: Turnover in senior operational leadership
notes: Planned succession should be distinguished where disclosed

name: Organisational restructuring signal
description: Material redesign of reporting lines operating model or organisation
notes: Do not infer benefit before delivery evidence

name: Recruitment constraint signal
description: Supported inability to recruit or retain required skills

name: Workforce productivity signal
description: Supported change in output or value added per workforce input
notes: Direction must be taken from the measured change

name: Supplier quality issue signal
description: Supported quality failure attributable to an external supplier

name: Shortage signal
description: Supported shortage of materials components labour or transport capacity

name: Lead time pressure signal
description: Supported extension or instability in supply or customer lead times

name: Inventory pressure signal
description: Operational evidence of excess buffer obsolete or constrained inventory
notes: Resilience build and unsold stock require contextual separation

name: Logistics disruption signal
description: Supported disruption to freight warehousing or distribution

name: Sourcing change signal
description: Material change in supplier geography concentration or make-buy approach
notes: Contextual modifier rather than directional score input

name: Transformation programme signal
description: Announced material operating or technology transformation
notes: Programme launch is not evidence of benefit

name: Implementation delay signal
description: Supported delay to a material operational or technology programme

name: Automation investment signal
description: Investment intended to automate operating activity
notes: Outcome and workforce context determine direction

name: ERP change signal
description: Implementation replacement or major change of enterprise systems
notes: Pressure eligible only with disruption delay or overrun evidence

name: Digital execution issue signal
description: Supported failure or disruption in digital operational execution

name: Capex expansion signal
description: Material increase in capital spending for growth or capacity
notes: Investment is not operational strength until conversion is evidenced

name: Acquisition integration signal
description: Observable progress or difficulty integrating an acquired operation
notes: Direction requires explicit progress or difficulty evidence

name: Investment productivity signal
description: Supported conversion of investment into output revenue or return
notes: Direction must be taken from measured conversion

name: Growth capacity signal
description: Supported availability of operational capacity for credible growth
notes: Demand visibility and utilisation are required context

name: Investment delay signal
description: Supported delay or deferral of material investment delivery
